unit_text:
[Unit]
Description=Stillyard standalone Linux scheduler
Requires=stillyard-delegation.service
After=stillyard-delegation.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=exec
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/python3 "/home/runner/.local/share/stillyard/libexec/native-linux-service.py" --root "/home/runner/.local/share/stillyard" --executors "/sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-1001.slice/user@1001.service/app.slice/stillyard-delegation.service/executors" --ram-mb 4096 --setup-only
ExecStart="/home/runner/.local/share/stillyard/bin/stillyard" daemon
WorkingDirectory=/home/runner/.local/share/stillyard
Environment="XDG_DATA_HOME=/home/runner/.local/share"
Slice=app.slice
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=10
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
UMask=0077
UnsetEnvironment=STILLYARD_STORE STILLYARD_ENDPOINT STILLYARD_JOB_ID STILLYARD_ATTEMPT STILLYARD_INVOCATION_ID STILLYARD_ROLE

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
delegation_unit_text:
[Unit]
Description=Stillyard retained native executor delegation
StopWhenUnneeded=no

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/true
RemainAfterExit=yes
Delegate=cpu memory pids
Slice=app.slice
KillMode=control-group
